title: Data source Permissions 'Role' picker only supports basic org roles
answers: Why can't I assign a custom/fixed RBAC role on a data source's Permissions tab?
What roles show up in the data source permission Role picker?
How do I give a custom-role user query access to a data source?
Data source permission Role dropdown is missing my custom role
body: Invariant: the Role option in a data source's Permissions tab only offers the basic organization roles Viewer, Editor, Admin — custom and fixed RBAC roles never appear there. Enforced by the UI using the OrgRole enum in public/app/features/datasources/components/AddPermission.tsx and by the backend API, which only accepts basic roles at POST .../builtInRoles/:builtInRole. To grant access to users with custom/fixed roles, assign the permission directly to the user, service account, or team, or grant the datasources:query action via RBAC — do not expect the Role picker to list custom roles. Docs describing this flow live in docs/sources/administration/data-source-management/_index.md and docs/sources/administration/roles-and-permissions/_index.md; keep them in sync if the picker's role set ever changes.
applies: Grafana data source permissions UI/API (Permissions tab 'Role' assignment), OSS/Enterprise/Cloud
